name: Sonarr
description: Smart PVR for newsgroup and bittorrent users.
one_liner: Free software that automatically finds and downloads new episodes of your favorite TV shows as soon as they're available, and keeps your collection organized.
buyer: No real commercial buyer — this is a mature, community-funded hobbyist tool for people running their own home media servers, and its core use case (automated torrent/usenet downloading) sits in a legal gray area that limits business use.
business_use_cases: A home-server hardware reseller bundles pre-configured 'media server' devices that include it, selling convenience rather than the software itself.
A hosting provider selling 'seedbox' or self-hosted app hosting includes one-click Sonarr deployment as a value-add for subscribers.
A tech YouTuber builds a home-lab tutorial series around it to grow an audience, monetizing content rather than the tool.

money_ideas.idea: Offer paid managed-hosting or one-click deployment of it as part of a broader self-hosted media server package.

steal_this: Not really a weekend business idea — it's a mature, donation-funded open-source project. The closest opportunity is a paid setup/hosting service around the broader self-hosted media stack it belongs to.
